theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.BridgeCertificate.valid
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {P : TState.ProblemSpec} {D : TState.EndpointPartition P}, TState.BridgeCertificate P D → TState.ValidEndpoint P D

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.CollapseEvent.conservative_covers
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {c : TState.CollapseEvent α}, c.Conservative → c.CoversPre

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.CollapseEvent.conservative_separates
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {c : TState.CollapseEvent α}, c.Conservative → c.Separates

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.DomainMorphism.comp_map
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {A : TState.DomainModel} {B : TState.DomainModel} {C : TState.DomainModel} (g : TState.DomainMorphism B C)   (f : TState.DomainMorphism A B) (x : A.Carrier), (g.comp f).map x = g.map (f.map x)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.DomainMorphism.id_map
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (A : TState.DomainModel) (x : A.Carrier), (TState.DomainMorphism.id A).map x = x

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.Horizon.neg_neg
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (h : TState.Horizon), h.neg.neg = h

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.LimitArithmetic.add_opposite_infinities
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: TState.LimitArithmetic.add TState.State.posInfinityAt TState.State.negInfinityAt =   TState.Outcome.exact (TState.State.indeterminate TState.IndeterminateForm.infinityMinusInfinity)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.LimitArithmetic.div_posInfinity_posInfinity
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: TState.LimitArithmetic.div TState.State.posInfinityAt TState.State.posInfinityAt =   TState.Outcome.exact (TState.State.indeterminate TState.IndeterminateForm.infinityOverInfinity)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.LimitArithmetic.mul_zero_posInfinity
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: TState.LimitArithmetic.mul (TState.State.finite 0) TState.State.posInfinityAt =   TState.Outcome.exact (TState.State.indeterminate TState.IndeterminateForm.zeroTimesInfinity)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.Outcome.map_exact
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (f : α → β) (a : α),   TState.Outcome.map f (TState.Outcome.exact a) = TState.Outcome.exact (f a)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.Outcome.map_undefined
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (f : α → β), TState.Outcome.map f TState.Outcome.undefined = TState.Outcome.undefined

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.Phase.flip_flip
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (p : TState.Phase), p.flip.flip = p

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.ProjectiveReal.reciprocal_infinity
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: TState.ProjectiveReal.infinity.reciprocal = TState.ProjectiveReal.finite 0

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.ProjectiveReal.reciprocal_involutive
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (x : TState.ProjectiveReal), x.reciprocal.reciprocal = x

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.ProjectiveReal.reciprocal_nonzero
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (x : ℝ), x ≠ 0 → (TState.ProjectiveReal.finite x).reciprocal = TState.ProjectiveReal.finite x⁻¹

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.ProjectiveReal.reciprocal_zero
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (TState.ProjectiveReal.finite 0).reciprocal = TState.ProjectiveReal.infinity

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.State.negate_involutive
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (s : TState.State), s.negate.negate = s

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.State.next_posInfinity_at
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: TState.State.posInfinityAt.structuralNext = some TState.State.posInfinityAfter

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.State.next_posInfinity_before
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: TState.State.posInfinityBefore.structuralNext = some TState.State.posInfinityAt

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.State.next_zero_at
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: TState.State.zeroAt.structuralNext = some TState.State.zeroAfter

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.State.next_zero_before
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: TState.State.zeroBefore.structuralNext = some TState.State.zeroAt

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.State.prev_zero_after
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: TState.State.zeroAfter.structuralPrev = some TState.State.zeroAt

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.StateArithmetic.add_finite
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (x y : ℝ),   TState.StateArithmetic.add (TState.State.finite x) (TState.State.finite y) =     TState.Outcome.exact (TState.State.finite (x + y))

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.StateArithmetic.div_finite_nonzero
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (x y : ℝ),   y ≠ 0 →     TState.StateArithmetic.div (TState.State.finite x) (TState.State.finite y) =       TState.Outcome.exact (TState.State.finite (x / y))

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.StateArithmetic.div_nonzero_zero
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (x : ℝ),   x ≠ 0 →     TState.StateArithmetic.div (TState.State.finite x) (TState.State.finite 0) =       TState.Outcome.family TState.StateArithmetic.poleFamily

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.StateArithmetic.div_zero_zero
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: TState.StateArithmetic.div (TState.State.finite 0) (TState.State.finite 0) =   TState.Outcome.exact (TState.State.indeterminate TState.IndeterminateForm.zeroOverZero)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.StateArithmetic.inv_negInfinity_after
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: TState.StateArithmetic.analyticInv TState.State.negInfinityAfter = TState.Outcome.exact TState.State.zeroBefore

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.StateArithmetic.inv_posInfinity_before
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: TState.StateArithmetic.analyticInv TState.State.posInfinityBefore = TState.Outcome.exact TState.State.zeroAfter

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.StateArithmetic.inv_zero_after
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: TState.StateArithmetic.analyticInv TState.State.zeroAfter = TState.Outcome.exact TState.State.posInfinityBefore

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.StateArithmetic.inv_zero_before
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: TState.StateArithmetic.analyticInv TState.State.zeroBefore = TState.Outcome.exact TState.State.negInfinityAfter

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.StateArithmetic.mul_finite
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (x y : ℝ),   TState.StateArithmetic.mul (TState.State.finite x) (TState.State.finite y) =     TState.Outcome.exact (TState.State.finite (x * y))

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.StateSystem.firstHit_unique
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (sys : TState.StateSystem) (K : TState.StateSet sys.State) (γ : sys.Trajectory) {m n : ℕ},   sys.FirstHit K γ m → sys.FirstHit K γ n → m = n

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.boundary_after_to_at
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (h : TState.Horizon),   (TState.State.boundary h TState.Phase.after).structuralPrev = some (TState.State.boundary h TState.Phase.at)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.boundary_at_to_after
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (h : TState.Horizon),   (TState.State.boundary h TState.Phase.at).structuralNext = some (TState.State.boundary h TState.Phase.after)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.boundary_before_to_at
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (h : TState.Horizon),   (TState.State.boundary h TState.Phase.before).structuralNext = some (TState.State.boundary h TState.Phase.at)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.bridge_allNegative_refutes_existential
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {P : TState.ProblemSpec} {D : TState.EndpointPartition P},   TState.BridgeCertificate P D → TState.AllNegative P D → ¬TState.ExistentialClaim P

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.bridge_allPositive_proves_universal
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {P : TState.ProblemSpec} {D : TState.EndpointPartition P},   TState.BridgeCertificate P D → TState.AllPositive P D → TState.UniversalClaim P

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.bridge_certificate_closes_model
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {P : TState.ProblemSpec} {D : TState.EndpointPartition P}, TState.BridgeCertificate P D → TState.ValidEndpoint P D

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.bridge_negativeWitness_refutes_universal
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {P : TState.ProblemSpec} {D : TState.EndpointPartition P},   TState.BridgeCertificate P D → ∀ (w : TState.NegativeClassifiedWitness P D), ¬TState.UniversalClaim P

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.bridge_positiveWitness_proves_existential
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {P : TState.ProblemSpec} {D : TState.EndpointPartition P},   TState.BridgeCertificate P D → ∀ (w : TState.PositiveClassifiedWitness P D), TState.ExistentialClaim P

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.exclusive_iff_no_overlap
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (P : TState.ProblemSpec) (D : TState.EndpointPartition P),   TState.Exclusive P D ↔ ¬Nonempty (TState.OverlapWitness P D)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.exhaustive_iff_no_gap
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (P : TState.ProblemSpec) (D : TState.EndpointPartition P), TState.Exhaustive P D ↔ ¬Nonempty (TState.GapWitness P D)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.gapWitness_refutes_exhaustive
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (P : TState.ProblemSpec) (D : TState.EndpointPartition P) (w : TState.GapWitness P D), ¬TState.Exhaustive P D

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.one_over_zero_classification
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: TState.StateArithmetic.div (TState.State.finite 1) (TState.State.finite 0) =   TState.Outcome.family TState.StateArithmetic.poleFamily

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.overlapWitness_refutes_exclusive
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (P : TState.ProblemSpec) (D : TState.EndpointPartition P) (w : TState.OverlapWitness P D), ¬TState.Exclusive P D

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.sigma_assoc
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (A B C : TState.StateSet α),   TState.SigmaOp (TState.SigmaOp A B) C = TState.SigmaOp A (TState.SigmaOp B C)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.sigma_comm
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (A B : TState.StateSet α), TState.SigmaOp A B = TState.SigmaOp B A

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.sigma_omega
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (A : TState.StateSet α), TState.SigmaOp A TState.OmegaOp = TState.OmegaOp

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.validEndpoint_iff_witness_free_adequate
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (P : TState.ProblemSpec) (D : TState.EndpointPartition P),   TState.ValidEndpoint P D ↔     ¬Nonempty (TState.GapWitness P D) ∧ ¬Nonempty (TState.OverlapWitness P D) ∧ TState.Adequate P D

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.validEndpoint_no_gap
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {P : TState.ProblemSpec} {D : TState.EndpointPartition P},   TState.ValidEndpoint P D → ¬Nonempty (TState.GapWitness P D)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.validEndpoint_no_overlap
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {P : TState.ProblemSpec} {D : TState.EndpointPartition P},   TState.ValidEndpoint P D → ¬Nonempty (TState.OverlapWitness P D)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.wrapped_after_posInfinity
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: TState.WrappedStep TState.State.posInfinityAfter TState.State.negInfinityBefore

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.wrapped_contains_structural
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {a b : TState.State}, a.structuralNext = some b → TState.WrappedStep a b

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TState.zero_over_zero_classification
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: TState.StateArithmetic.div (TState.State.finite 0) (TState.State.finite 0) =   TState.Outcome.exact (TState.State.indeterminate TState.IndeterminateForm.zeroOverZero)
